Scope: sewage, storm water (with ponds and open channels), irrigation and potable water networks, 13.8 kV cable, street lighting, telecom ducts, and internal and external roads with asphalt and sidewalks.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. On 08-Nov-2026 the project is 99.21% complete against 99.93% planned, behind by 0.72% (SPI 0.99). This week gained 0.03% (15 of 48,045 man-hours, all in New Scope), against 0.13% the week before. The revised completion date of 26-Sep-2026 has passed.

The revised completion date has passed, and the P6 finish slipped another week: it is now 94 days late. The contract completion was extended by two months to 26-Sep-2026 (CCO 2, approved 29-Jun-2026). The weekly report still forecasts completion on 30-Nov-2026, 65 days late. The P6 remaining-activities list of 08-Nov-2026 finishes the project on 29-Dec-2026, a week later than the 22-Dec-2026 of the previous update. In P6 the storm network still finishes zone by zone, now between 14-Nov and 01-Dec-2026 (Z02, Z11, Z04, Z05, Z08), all works including testing and commissioning on 01-Dec-2026 (24-Nov-2026 last week), and the approval of all as-built drawings on 15-Nov-2026 (08-Nov-2026 last week).

Revised quantities are far below the original BOQ for roadsThe revised BOQ, still marked "under review", sets each total equal to the installed quantity. For road works it is a small part of the original BOQ: asphalt wearing course 1,240 of 63,689 m³, precast kerb K1-D 15,100 of 187,209 m, kerb L1 1,972 of 123,805 m and interlock 1,576 of 59,537 m².
The sheet conflicts with the remaining-activities listThe P6 remaining-activities list of 08-Nov-2026 still has uPVC 300 mm and GRP 400 mm catch-basin lines to excavate, lay, test or backfill on Main Roads and in zones Z02, Z04, Z05, Z06, Z08, Z09, Z10 and Z11, finishing between 10-Nov and 01-Dec-2026. In Z04, Z08 and Z11 some lines have not started. The quantities above therefore overstate what is installed.
Medium-voltage works revised to zeroThe 13.8 kV cable (30,720 m in the original BOQ), its joints and terminations, the 950 m duct bank, the normally-open RMUs and the three street-lighting substations and RMUs all have a revised quantity of 0. They are left out of the table.

Data notes

  • Week number: the Milestones sheet states contract week 119 ("119 of 103"), which is used. Counting whole weeks from site handover (29-Jul-2024) gives 118, because contract weeks count from 1.
  • Major Quantities is unchanged since 18-Oct-2026 and shows every item 100% installed, while the P6 remaining-activities list of 08-Nov-2026 still has catch-basin lines open on Main Roads and in eight zones until 01-Dec-2026.
  • The P6 summary in the Progress sheet still shows the 01-Nov-2026 schedule (project finish 22-Dec-2026, −87 days float, construction finish 24-Nov-2026), while the P6 printouts of 08-Nov-2026 finish the project on 29-Dec-2026 and construction on 01-Dec-2026. No XER was uploaded this week, so P6 float is not available.
  • The weekly report keeps its completion forecast at 30-Nov-2026, while P6 gives 29-Dec-2026. P6 forecasts the "Complete Demobilization" milestone on 08-Nov-2026, while its demobilisation activities run from 06 to 29-Dec-2026. The weekly report gives the existing-condition survey as finished in July 2025 while P6 still has it open.
  • The Physical-Chart Data sheet was not updated: its last actual point is still October (47,652 man-hours, stated as 99.25% against 48,012). This report uses the 48,045 budget of the Progress sheet (99.21% on 08-Nov-2026).
  • The HSE and Quality sheets repeat the 01-Nov-2026 figures except the inspection date (15,300 man-hours and 10 toolbox talks again this week, 791 FIRs pending).
  • The As-Built Tracker of 07-Nov-2026 counts 987 drawings in total, against 980 on 25-Oct-2026.
  • The 15 site photos have no date, GPS stamp or EXIF data; titles come from their file names. The Procurement Tracker is still dated 23-Aug-2026.
  • Manpower: the October head count (1,092 manual, 92 non-manual) is repeated for the fourth week and does not match the trade breakdown (389); monthly actuals stop at January 2026.
  • The invoice summary shows 0 submitted invoices while the log lists 25. The Testing sheet still shows 0% for all systems, while P6 has testing and commissioning in progress until 01-Dec-2026.
  • The workbook also reports cost-based progress (value-weighted) and labels it as planned and actual. This report uses physical % complete (man-hour weighted) only.
